svg.text: CUDA Templates for Linear Algebra - CuTe - 5-Layer GEMM Hierarchy - docs.nvidia.com/cutlass
L1 - Downstream Consumers (frameworks + libraries built on CUTLASS)
L2 - Programming Frontends (C++ template metaprogramming + CuTe Python DSL)
L3 - Device Layer (host-side GEMM handle + launch orchestration)
L4 - Kernel Layer (device grid over threadblock clusters + tile scheduling)
Stateless universal kernel - mainloop + epilogue composition
Works for CUTLASS 2.x and 3.x via Shape detection
ClusterTileM/N loops - hardware raster or persistent scheduler
Threadblock clusters - TMA multicast across CTAs
L5 - Collective Layer (temporal micro-kernels: mainloop k-tile + epilogue fusion)
Largest cooperating thread set for tiled MMA/copy atoms
k_tile loop - async GMEM->SMEM - pipelined stages
EVT Epilogue Visitor Tree - bias/act/aux fusion
Mainloop fusion hooks at collective layer
L6 - Tiled MMA/Copy + Atom Layer (CuTe spatial micro-kernels)
Tile MMA atoms across threads/data with permutations
Fully static inner loops - fully unrolled micro-kernels
Same vocabulary for thread tensors and data tensors
L7 - NVIDIA GPU Hardware (Volta SM70 through Blackwell SM103)
Bottom-up composition: atoms - tiled ops - collective - kernel - device adapter
Step 2: DefaultEpilogue / EVT -> CollectiveEpilogue (fusion + type convert)
Alt: CuTe DSL Python kernel - same abstractions - faster iteration - DL framework native
Triply nested loop maps: cluster tiles - k_tile mainloop - tiled_mma inner unrolled loops
Warp-specialized algorithms decouple TMA load warps from MMA/epilogue warps
Hardware-detached interface - orthogonal composable layers - tag dispatch extension points
CuTe layouts: correct-by-construction - reuse across arch generations - peak tensor core utilization
Design Position (modular CUDA GEMM construction kit + CuTe tensor algebra)
Not a monolithic BLAS - composable templates/DSL for custom high-perf linear algebra kernels
Init: pick frontend - configure CollectiveBuilder or write CuTe DSL - compile - GemmUniversalAdapter::run
Sources: docs.nvidia.com/cutlass - github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass - NVIDIA CUTLASS 3.x/4.x technical blogs - arXiv GEMM hierarchy
